decisions.reason: The consumer superfood drink lies far from the firm's engineering core, it has not shown up on the website since 2018, and dropping the flagship plants in 2019 already showed the firm cuts products that miss aspirations, so problemistic search points to freeing these resources for core waste-to-energy ventures.

The modular plant extensions build directly on the established waste-to-energy offer and serve existing customers, and the firm is still hiring, so slack allows it to carry the line despite the lack of recent visibility.
